title: Claims that must not appear without evidence
text: Standalone bacterial species identification from a BME690 or any VOC sensor.
Microgram biomass measurement from an integrated load cell.
Exact MIC calculated from a disk-diffusion zone.
LLM-generated or automatically inferred CLSI/EUCAST breakpoints.
Clinical diagnosis or resistance-gene confirmation from morphology alone.
A fixed regulatory class before formal intended-use assessment.
Replacement of a biosafety cabinet or established laboratory containment.
